_comment: Tier-2 for skfem poisson#4. Confirms the 2026-08-03 correction (a DofsView and its .flatten() give BIT-IDENTICAL results, so the old 'silently wrong results' warning was stale) and pins the form that IS silently wrong, which the claim does not mention: a BOOLEAN MASK. condense(K, f, D=mask) is accepted without any warning and treats True/False as the integer indices 1/0, so almost nothing is constrained -- measured max|u| 8.8e-01 against the correct 7.03e-02 on MeshTri().refined(2) with unit_load. An empty D gives 5.6e+14 garbage.
